narrative.overview: The site reads like a coach's training notebook, kept clean: a chalk-white page, black ink, one vermilion mark where it matters, and a yellow signal for the next action. It is sporty and dynamic in its type and calm and reassuring in everything around it. Every section is built to fit one screen, on a computer and on a phone. Surfaces are flat and crisp at rest; the only movement is a short lift on hover.
keyCharacteristics: Chalk (#F4F3EF) and white grounds, ink text, never a dark full-page theme.
One loud colour per screen: vermilion is a signature, yellow is an action.
Hanken Grotesk only on the site: Black for titles, Regular for reading, italic only for the home tagline.
Pill buttons and bubbles, 16px cards, flat at rest.
Small spaced capitals only for surtitles, the menu and RIMAACTIVE.
One section = one screen, desktop and phone.

rules.name: The One Loud Colour Rule
rules.body: Only one vivid colour fills a large area on any screen. Vermilion signs, yellow acts; they never compete side by side as surfaces.

rules.name: The Yellow Never Reads Rule
rules.body: Yellow is never text on chalk or white (1.5:1). As text it only appears on a dark photo or the ink veil.

rules.name: The Alternating Ground Rule
rules.body: Home sections alternate chalk and white across the full width; cards switch to chalk on white sections so they stay visible.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Titles take one capital at the start and nothing else (proper names keep theirs). Capitals are reserved for the 12px spaced label style.

rules.name: The Same Size Rule
rules.body: Text of the same role has the same size and placement everywhere on a page. A section title on "Mes offres" never differs from its sibling sections.

rules.name: The Flat At Rest Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats until it is touched. Lifts use cubic-bezier(.3, .7, .2, 1) over 0.35s and are removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

dos: Do use only the charter colours: craie #F4F3EF, blanc, craie foncé #E8E5DE, encre #161514, vermillon #FF4A1C, jaune signal #F2C230, gris chaud #57534E.
Do keep one primary yellow button per screen, with ink text.
Do make every section fit one screen on computer and phone, and check it at several sizes.
Do keep the same size and placement for text of the same role across a page.
Do use real photos of Marie in natural light, colour or clean black and white, with her face fully visible.
Do write in French, with "vous", sentence-case titles and no emoji.
donts: Don't put yellow text on chalk or white.
Don't use vermilion text under 24px, or chalk text on vermilion.
Don't add blue, pink, neon, gradients other than the ink veil, or a second vivid colour on a large surface.
Don't use capitals outside the 12px spaced label style.
Don't tilt photos, add coloured filters, stock images, before/after shots or close-ups of bodies.
Don't use dotted lines, gauges, labels, coloured blocks or coloured icons.
Don't add a phone number, testimonials, figures or claims that Marie has not given.
